youtube.title: Why Bananas Curve Like That 🍌 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Young banana fruits, called fingers, first point toward the ground, then curve upward. This is negative gravitropism: the plant senses gravity, and growth hormones called auxins gather on the lower side of each fruit. The lower side then grows faster than the upper side, which bends the fruit toward the sky and gives the bunch its curve.
